verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a legal services firm offering immigration, incorporation, and equity work rather than a software product. Opting out of product telemetry and usage tracking is a software privacy axis, so it does not fit this kind of offering. The evidence pack shows no software product, client app, or tooling that would collect telemetry, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
